select t1.id, t1.code, t1.name, t2.version from bp_code_rule t1 left join bp_code_rule_version t2 on t1.code = t2.rule_code AND t2.STATUS = 1 AND t2.is_deleted = 0 where t1.is_deleted = 0
and t1.code like concat('%',#{code},'%')
and t1.name like concat('%',#{name},'%')
and t1.id in (select code_rule_id from bp_code_rule_dept where dept_id in
#{item} )
order by t1.create_time desc

select t1.id, t2.id as versionId, t1.code, t1.name, t2.dict_id, t2.version, t2.description, t2.reset_rule from bp_code_rule t1 inner join bp_code_rule_version t2 on t1.code = t2.rule_code where t2.id = #{versionId}
